Operational Instructions

How to Charge Your Car Using the Exploren App
Step 1: Plug the cable into your car. Note the port number you used.
Step 2: In the Exploren app, tap the QR code button at the bottom right.
Step 3: Scan the QR code on the sticker near your charging port.
Step 4: Read the charger info, then tap “Start Charging.”
Step 5: When you want to stop, open the app and tap “Stop Charging.”
Chargers are located to left of the store entrance by Victoria Road
